0022600223.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, 4-6 over their last ten) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-3 at home) with the Pelicans on a three-game losing streak, sitting 5 games back in the Southwest and 12th in the West, while Brooklyn is on a two-game skid and 13th in the East. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Pelicans won the last meeting 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026, with no games yet between them this season. New Orleans is missing Trendon Watford (ankle) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), both out, and Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), who is out, plus Mikel Brown Jr. (illness) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness), who are both day-to-day, with Traore also a game-time decision.
